player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Submit your move as **[macro  micro]** (two numbers 0-8):
• *macro*  = which mini-board you play in
• *micro* = which square inside that mini-board
Example `[7 8]` ➜ place your mark in mini-board 7, square 8, and
force your opponent to play in mini-board 8 next.

You are `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Pindhah kudu ing wangun [macro micro] kanthi nomer 0-8.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: Papan mikro, baris utawa kolom ora ana ing kisaran.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: Pemain kudu main ing papan mikro sabanjure.

game_action.played: Player {player_id} main ing micro board {macro_idx}, sel {micro_idx} (baris {row}, kolom {col}). Player {opponent_id} kudu main ing {nxt_txt}.

outcome.win: Pemain {player_id} menang Ultimate Tic Tac Toe!
